control.title: Payment system data stored only in India
control.description: Store all payment system data (end-to-end transaction details and customer data collected for payments) only in India, delete any copy processed abroad within the permitted time, and report compliance (with a system audit) as RBI requires.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Data location inventory with hosting regions, cloud region configuration, data localisation audit report.
acceptance_criteria: An inventory or configuration showing where payment data is stored, all in India
A data localisation audit or compliance confirmation where RBI requires it

requirements.title: Payment data stored in India
requirements.guidance: Follow the payment system data storage rules (circular of 6 April 2018): store payment data only in India.
